_noteP: Voracity (KatarinaPassiveAbility, child spell KatarinaDaggerPickupPBAoE) has TWO components: the cooldown-reset-on-takedown mechanic (no damage, not modeled) and a SEPARATE 'Dagger Slash' AoE proc -- confirmed via live source (mobafire Voracity page): 'When Katarina picks up a dagger, she performs an area slash dealing magic damage' with base damage scaling by level, 70-100% AP, +0.6 bonus AD. This matches the BIN exactly: 'TotalDamage' = ByCharLevelFormula(base 68.2->495.2 by champion level) + StatByNamedDataValue(mStat=2 bonus AD, BonusADRatio=0.6) + StatBySubPart(AP-scaled, subpart ByCharLevelBreakpoints 0.7->1.0 by level). Curated as a P bonusEffect trigger onAbility (approximated as firing whenever an ability is cast, since Katarina's combo routinely drops and picks daggers back up via Q/E -- not a strict guarantee on every single ability cast, same simplification style used elsewhere in this project for proc-based passives).
_noteRidesP: (2026-10-20, M45 loop 43) Voracity: the slash is dealt when Katarina PICKS UP a dagger - where a dagger lands and whether she reaches it is not the combo's to know, so it is the user's to attach ('+fx', manualOnly) to the node that picks one up. It rode every cast, R included.
